text_en: These are the names of the tribes: Beginning at the northern border, on the Hethlon road, from Lebo-hamath, as far as Hazar-enon (which is on the border of Damascus, with Hamath to the north), and extending from the east side to the west, Dan, one portion.
text_cn: 各支派的名字如下：由极北端起，沿赫特隆路至哈玛特口，再至哈匝尔南； —— 北有大马士革边界，有哈玛特边界 —— 每支派由东界到西界各有一份：这是丹的一份。

text_en: Adjoining the territory of Dan, from the east side to the west, Asher, one portion.
text_cn: 靠近丹的边界，由东界到西界，是阿协尔的一份。

text_en: Adjoining the territory of Asher, from the east side to the west, Naphtali, one portion.
text_cn: 靠近阿协尔的边界，由东界到西界，是纳斐塔里的一份。

text_en: Adjoining the territory of Naphtali, from the east side to the west, Manasseh, one portion.
text_cn: 靠近纳斐塔里的边界，由东界到西界，是默纳协的一份。

text_en: Adjoining the territory of Manasseh, from the east side to the west, Ephraim, one portion.
text_cn: 靠近默纳协的边界，由东界到西界是厄弗辣因的一份。

text_en: Adjoining the territory of Ephraim, from the east side to the west, Reuben, one portion.
text_cn: 靠近厄弗辣因的边界，由东界到西界是勒乌本的一份。

text_en: Adjoining the territory of Reuben, from the east side to the west, Judah, one portion.
text_cn: 靠近勒乌本的边界，由东界到西界是犹大的一份。

text_en: Adjoining the territory of Judah, from the east side to the west, shall be the portion that you shall set apart, twenty-five thousand cubits in width, and in length equal to one of the tribal portions, from the east side to the west, with the sanctuary in the middle of it.
text_cn: 靠近犹大的边界，由东界到西界，是你们应保留的献地，宽二万五千肘，长由东界到西界，如每支派分得的一份一样，中间是圣所。

text_en: The portion that you shall set apart for the Lord shall be twenty-five thousand cubits in length, and twenty thousand in width.
text_cn: 你们为上主保留的献地，长二万五千肘，宽一万肘。

text_en: These shall be the allotments of the holy portion: the priests shall have an allotment measuring twenty-five thousand cubits on the northern side, ten thousand cubits in width on the western side, ten thousand in width on the eastern side, and twenty-five thousand in length on the southern side, with the sanctuary of the Lord in the middle of it.
text_cn: 这块所献的圣地应归司祭，北面长二万五千肘，西面宽一万肘，东面宽一万肘，南面长二万五千肘，中间是上主的圣所。

text_en: This shall be for the consecrated priests, the descendants of Zadok, who kept my charge, who did not go astray when the people of Israel went astray, as the Levites did.
text_cn: 这地应归被祝圣作司祭的匝多克的子孙，他们谨慎遵行了我的礼规，当以色列子民堕落时，他们没有像肋未人一样堕落下去。

text_en: It shall belong to them as a special portion from the holy portion of the land, a most holy place, adjoining the territory of the Levites.
text_cn: 属司祭的地是献地中至圣之地，靠近肋未人的边界。

text_en: Alongside the territory of the priests, the Levites shall have an allotment twenty-five thousand cubits in length and ten thousand in width. The whole length shall be twenty-five thousand cubits and the width twenty thousand.
text_cn: 属肋未人的地与司祭的边界平行，长二万五千肘，宽一万肘，总计长二万五千肘，宽二万肘。

text_en: They shall not sell or exchange any of it; they shall not transfer this choice portion of the land, for it is holy to the Lord .
text_cn: 其中的地不可变卖，不可交换，也不可转让，这是地中最好的一份，因为是祝圣于上主的。

text_en: The remainder, five thousand cubits in width and twenty-five thousand in length, shall be for ordinary use for the city, for dwellings and for open country. In the middle of it shall be the city;
text_cn: 由二万五千肘的面积所余的五千肘应列为俗地，作为居住的城市和郊区，城市应在中心。

text_en: and these shall be its dimensions: the north side four thousand five hundred cubits, the south side four thousand five hundred, the east side four thousand five hundred, and the west side four thousand five hundred.
text_cn: 城市的面积如下：北面四千五百肘，南面四千五百肘，东面四千五百肘，西面四千五百肘。

text_en: The city shall have open land: on the north two hundred fifty cubits, on the south two hundred fifty, on the east two hundred fifty, on the west two hundred fifty.
text_cn: 城市外的郊区是：北面二百五十肘，南面二百五十肘，东面二百五十肘，西面二百五十肘。

text_en: The remainder of the length alongside the holy portion shall be ten thousand cubits to the east, and ten thousand to the west, and it shall be alongside the holy portion. Its produce shall be food for the workers of the city.
text_cn: 至于那与所献圣地平行的所余之地，东面长一万肘，西面长一万肘，其中出产应作为城内居民的食粮。

text_en: The workers of the city, from all the tribes of Israel, shall cultivate it.
text_cn: 城内的居民是由以色列各支派分派来住的。

text_en: The whole portion that you shall set apart shall be twenty-five thousand cubits square, that is, the holy portion together with the property of the city.
text_cn: 整个献地为二万五千肘长，二万五千肘宽，为一方形，是你们应保留的所献圣地和城市地段。

text_en: What remains on both sides of the holy portion and of the property of the city shall belong to the prince. Extending from the twenty-five thousand cubits of the holy portion to the east border, and westward from the twenty-five thousand cubits to the west border, parallel to the tribal portions, it shall belong to the prince. The holy portion with the sanctuary of the temple in the middle of it,
text_cn: 在所献圣地与城市地段的两边所余之地，二万五千肘以东至东面的边界，二万五千肘以西至西面的边界，与各支派所分之地平行，都归元首，所献圣地与圣所在中间。

text_en: and the property of the Levites and of the city, shall be in the middle of that which belongs to the prince. The portion of the prince shall lie between the territory of Judah and the territory of Benjamin.
text_cn: 除在属元首的地中间，有肋未人的产业和城市地段外，凡在犹大边界与本雅明边界之间的土地，皆归元首所有。

text_en: As for the rest of the tribes: from the east side to the west, Benjamin, one portion.
text_cn: 至于其余的支派：由东界到西界，是本雅明的一份。

text_en: Adjoining the territory of Benjamin, from the east side to the west, Simeon, one portion.
text_cn: 靠近本雅明的边界，由东界至西界是西默盎的一份。

text_en: Adjoining the territory of Simeon, from the east side to the west, Issachar, one portion.
text_cn: 靠近西默盎的边界，由东界到西界是依撒加尔的一份。

text_en: Adjoining the territory of Issachar, from the east side to the west, Zebulun, one portion.
text_cn: 靠近依撒加尔的边界，由东界到西界是则步隆的一份。

text_en: Adjoining the territory of Zebulun, from the east side to the west, Gad, one portion.
text_cn: 靠近则步隆的边界，由东界到西界，是加得的一份。

text_en: And adjoining the territory of Gad to the south, the boundary shall run from Tamar to the waters of Meribath-kadesh, from there along the Wadi of Egypt to the Great Sea.
text_cn: 靠近加得的边界，是南方向阳的边界，由塔玛尔到默黎巴卡德士水，沿河直到大海。

text_en: This is the land that you shall allot as an inheritance among the tribes of Israel, and these are their portions, says the Lord God .
text_cn: 这是你们为以色列各支派抽签平分的土地，是你们应得的产业 —— 吾主上主的断语。

text_en: These shall be the exits of the city: On the north side, which is to be four thousand five hundred cubits by measure,
text_cn: 城的出口如下：北面为四千五百肘，

text_en: three gates, the gate of Reuben, the gate of Judah, and the gate of Levi, the gates of the city being named after the tribes of Israel.
text_cn: 北面有三门：一为勒乌本门，一为犹大门，一为肋未门。城门都是照以色列支派的名字起的。

text_en: On the east side, which is to be four thousand five hundred cubits, three gates, the gate of Joseph, the gate of Benjamin, and the gate of Dan.
text_cn: 东面为四千五百肘，有三门：一为若瑟门，一为本雅明门，一为丹门。

text_en: On the south side, which is to be four thousand five hundred cubits by measure, three gates, the gate of Simeon, the gate of Issachar, and the gate of Zebulun.
text_cn: 南面为四千五百肘，有三门：一为西默盎门，一为依撒加尔门，一为则步隆门。

text_en: On the west side, which is to be four thousand five hundred cubits, three gates, the gate of Gad, the gate of Asher, and the gate of Naphtali.
text_cn: 西面为四千五百肘，有三门：一为加得门，一为阿协尔门，一为纳斐塔里门。

text_en: The circumference of the city shall be eighteen thousand cubits. And the name of the city from that time on shall be, The Lord is There.
text_cn: 周围共一万八千肘。这城从那天起名叫“上主在那里。”
